comments.author: DPiano
comments.body:
Wow, ranking up storage past r10 is complicated, ranking it to r16 is soo hard.

Any idea to rank it up fast? Even having a farm with items used for high rank recipes it's hard, well, even having a high rank collection/procurement is hard and takes a lot of time.

I convert berries lime juice at rank 7 but it takes too much berries and no profit. Also try bark and exotic fruits at ranks above 10 but it's the same, too much good and too much time to get some points.

This recipe seem cool but to get 3,000 sand to do 100 production and get failure (even with oxford skills)... Well, it doesn't worth it

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: Converting mako sharks and swordfish to fish-the-trade-good is probably the most efficient recipe all the way to max storage. But since in this process fishing gets maxed much earlier than storage, you may be tempted to accept taking some more time in this process and use the exotic fruits or bark recipes, in order to gain some extra ranks in procurement / collection skills (sanity check: I hope you have oxford field activities 1&2 loaded when fishing / procuring / collecting). Or you may not, it's up to you. If you haven't maxed management, do storage at sea to gain management points too while at it.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Once I could reach r13 Storage with boosters, I used the Dyeing Secrets book to convert Large Leaves into Cochineal. It works out good because, in my experience, the best place to get Large Leaves is by the stacked boulders on the outskirts of Portobelo and Portobelo has a vigor food clerk so you don't ever have to worry about running out. Anyway, I used that recipe all the way up to r15 storage until I stopped grinding.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I like the same strategy Curious mentioned, though I also grew ex. fruits, leaves and berries on my farms to help push things along. Every little bit helps when it comes to skill grinding.

Also, if you're heading into town to replenish vigor food stores, consider using a course meal to fully recharge while you're at it; in that town, Acai Juice + Sopa de tortilla x3 + Acai Juice is the magic "max vigor recharge" combo. That way, you can take your newly bought vigor food with you back out into the wild, and digest your course meal by the time you need to go back into town again.

... Just a thought, of course. Play as you see fit.
